en: Glory to God in the highest
and on earth peace to men of good will.
We give you thanks for your great glory.
Lord God, heavenly king, God the Father almighty.
Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father.
You who take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us.
You who take away the sins of the world, receive our plea.
You who sit at the right hand of the Father, have mercy on us.
You alone are most high, Jesus Christ.
With the Holy Spirit, in the glory of God the Father. Amen.
notes: line 1.2: 'hominibus bonae voluntatis' may be 'men of good will' or 'men of (God's) good pleasure'.
